question.text: An optically active alkyl halide \(\mathrm{C}_4 \mathrm{H}_9 \mathrm{Br}\) [A] reacts with hot KOH dissolved in ethanol and forms alkene [B] as major product which reacts with bromine to give dibromide [C]. The compound [C] is converted into a gas [D] upon reacting with alcoholic \(\mathrm{NaNH}_2\). During hydration 18 gram of water is added to 1 mole of gas [D] on warming with mercuric sulphate and dilute acid at 333 K to form compound [E]. The IUPAC name of compound \([\mathrm{E}]\) is :
